# SEO Cluster

A specialised sub-skill of the claude-seo family (orchestrated by the seo skill, a separate listing): it clusters keywords by real SERP overlap and designs hub-and-spoke content architecture with an internal link matrix and an interactive cluster map. At use it queries WebSearch (optional paid DataForSEO MCP after a cost check) and writes plan, map, brief and scorecard files into the working directory; executing a plan writes the posts themselves only through the separate claude-blog plugin, otherwise it writes briefs. The generated cluster map carries a fixed 'Generated by Claude SEO' footer; the text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions.
